before.content:
$repo = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..')).Path
$output = Join-Path $repo 'build/stage6-release'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $output | Out-Null

& "$PSScriptRoot\verify-stage5.ps1"
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

Invoke-Checked { & "$repo\gradlew.bat" stage6Check --offline --no-daemon } 'Stage 6 Java gate'
Invoke-Checked { corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline } 'frozen pnpm install'
Invoke-Checked { corepack pnpm check:generated } 'generated contracts'
Invoke-Checked { corepack pnpm check:acp } 'ACP contracts'
Invoke-Checked { corepack pnpm check:hcp } 'HCP and Buf contracts'
Invoke-Checked { corepack pnpm check:modules } 'module boundaries'
Invoke-Checked { corepack pnpm check:naming } 'public naming'
Invoke-Checked { node "$repo\scripts\generate-sbom.mjs" $output } 'CycloneDX SBOM'
Invoke-Checked { node "$repo\scripts\generate-provenance.mjs" $output } 'build provenance'
Invoke-Checked { node "$repo\scripts\sign-stage6-release.mjs" $output } 'release signatures'
Invoke-Checked { & "$repo\scripts\verify-stage6-consumers.ps1" } 'staged BOM consumer'

$sbom = Get-Content (Join-Path $output 'ji.cdx.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
if ($sbom.bomFormat -ne 'CycloneDX' -or $sbom.components.Count -lt 1) { throw 'SBOM is incomplete' }
$provenance = Get-Content (Join-Path $output 'provenance.intoto.jsonl') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
if ($provenance.predicateType -ne 'https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1') { throw 'provenance is incomplete' }
